blocks.text: Match preview: Kuwait face Singapore in 6th Match, Group B (ODI) on Tue, 1 Sept, 2026, 7:00 am at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval Bangi. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Standard ODI surface expected. Conditions will be clearer at the toss — monitor team selection and dew factor for night games.
Expected par score: 250–290 runs par score.
Thunderstorm · High 35°C / Low 25°C · Rain: 3.8 mm · Wind: up to 14 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
